nodes.label: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Ignore-list config for the understand-anything analyzer; lists glob patterns (23 non-empty lines) excluding files/dirs from the knowledge-graph scan.

nodes.label: config.json
nodes.summary: understand-anything project config; sets outputLanguage for generated analysis content.

nodes.label: probe-input.json
nodes.summary: Transient probe input for the analyzer: holds projectRoot, batchFiles and batchImportData for a structure-extraction probe run.

nodes.label: probe-output.json
nodes.summary: Transient probe output (959 lines) from a structure-extraction run: scriptCompleted flag, filesAnalyzed count, filesSkipped list and per-file results.

nodes.label: check_tasks.js
nodes.summary: Small backend diagnostic script (11 lines) that queries SearchTask records via Prisma to inspect task state.

nodes.label: scripts/check_tasks.js
nodes.summary: Backend utility script (12 lines) under scripts/ that inspects SearchTask rows via Prisma for debugging.

nodes.label: check_dallas.js
nodes.summary: Root-level ad-hoc diagnostic script (59 non-empty lines) checking Dallas-related lead/domain data in the database via Prisma.

nodes.label: check_db.js
nodes.summary: Root-level database smoke-check script (13 lines) connecting via Prisma to verify DB connectivity/state.

nodes.label: migration_lock.toml
nodes.summary: Prisma migrations lock file pinning the migration provider (PostgreSQL).

nodes.label: schema.prisma
nodes.summary: Master Prisma schema (849 lines, 788 non-empty) defining the PostgreSQL data model: User/auth, Campaign/Template/SenderAccount, Lead/Email pipeline, Domain portfolio, Watchlist, Mailbox/Inbox and analytics models plus the generator/datasource config.

nodes.label: generateQueryVariations
nodes.summary: Exported function (lines 4-99) building a deduplicated set of search-query variations from a keyword, country and city/state, scaling count to targetLeadCount and applying synonym/localization expansion.

nodes.label: addLocalizedQueryVariations
nodes.summary: Helper (lines 101-119) that appends location-qualified variants of a base query into the variations set using the provided location variants.

nodes.label: normalizePhrase
nodes.summary: Helper (lines 121-127) normalizing a phrase: lowercasing, stripping non-word/comma chars, collapsing whitespace and trimming.

nodes.label: getLocationVariants
nodes.summary: Helper (lines 129-149) deriving a deduplicated list of location strings (country, city/state, city-only forms) for query localization.

nodes.label: queryGenerator.ts
nodes.summary: Search-query generation service: exports generateQueryVariations to expand a keyword + location into many deduplicated search phrases via synonyms and location variants; supporting helpers addLocalizedQueryVariations, normalizePhrase, getLocationVariants.
